title: Migrate customer, vendor and item transactions for BC14 cloud migration
summary: Extends BC14 cloud migration to stage customer, vendor, and item subledger transactions alongside G/L entries, enabling migration of open receivables, payables, and inventory for both current and historical data.
key_points: Adds buffer tables for customer, vendor and item ledger entries, detailed ledger entries, value entries and inventory posting setup
Current migrators post open customer and vendor entries through general journals and rebuild on-hand inventory through positive adjustment item journal lines
Automatic Cost Posting is left off so item posting does not double-count against the G/L migrator
Historical migrators copy source entries into archive tables in the HybridBC14HistoricalData app without posting
Each migrator runs only when its module flag is enabled; tests cover the current migrators and the item historical migrator
